decisions.reason: As a close-to-core digital workflow extension with clear fit to regulatory and practice digitization needs, its option value likely still exceeds its carrying cost.

The education institute uses existing training and customer relationships, so despite being more resource-intensive than software it still plausibly supports the core business and remains worth keeping.
A remote support tool is tightly linked to the firm's installed base and service model, making it a relatively low-cost option to retain even if differentiation is limited.
The analytics dashboard fits the firm's direction toward more digital and efficient practice management, so management would likely continue it while market potential develops further.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely inexpensive to maintain as a commercial package, so there is little reason to remove it.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the core software business and likely requires distinct capabilities and marketplace scale, so its option value is less likely to justify continued commitment.
